requirement: Security analytics lifecycle: framed problem, collection, preparation, analysis, interpretation, action, feedback
method: Documented pipeline stages s01-s16 with logs and provenance files

requirement: At least three distinct security data sources, one identity/access and one network/endpoint/OT
datasets: ToN_IoT IIoT telemetry; ToN_IoT network flows; synthetic remote-access log; ATT&CK ICS text; asset + user context

requirement: Data engineering and baseline: dictionary, provenance, cleaning log, descriptive statistics, visual baselines
Machine learning: at least one supervised model and one unsupervised/anomaly method
datasets: IIoT telemetry (supervised), network flows + access log (unsupervised)
method: Logistic Regression / Decision Tree / Random Forest; Isolation Forest, LOF, behavioural baselines

requirement: Security investigation: correlated timeline, affected entities, response actions
datasets: access log + IIoT telemetry + network flows + asset/user context
method: Multi-source correlation on time, account and asset

requirement: Security intelligence: requirements, enrichment, operational and executive products
datasets: all analytical outputs + ATT&CK ICS text
method: PIR definition, ATT&CK enrichment, tiered reporting

requirement: Simulation comparing at least three control scenarios
datasets: network topology derived from asset inventory + observed attack mix
method: Monte Carlo propagation model, >=1000 iterations per scenario

requirement: Text mining/NLP on unstructured security text
method: Cleaning, TF-IDF, supervised classification, indicator/entity extraction, topic view

requirement: Predictive risk/forecast and at least three adversarial or robustness tests
method: Interpretable daily risk score + drift/noise/evasion/missing-data tests
